analysis: Provided-feature-only facility spatial-catchment prior sensitivity; no accuracy test or target fit
limitations: Centroid-based Euclidean catchment is a spatial context proxy, not a road-network/service-area model or a validation of facility completeness.
Population is available only at tract scale; population-weighted access assigns the tract total to its centroid and does not model within-tract population distribution.
A nearby Overture facility is not proof that an unobserved facility is absent or that an emergency service is accessible.
The existing fixed pooled logistic prior is an explicit model assumption; the fixed catchment uplift is a sensitivity, not empirically calibrated or accuracy tested.

measure_after.deterministic_rerun: candidate, report and manifest were rerun and compared byte-for-byte

existing_task_report.meaning: Freeze the existing pooled logistic facility-miss prior and category/zero-share report as baseline; do not refit its coefficients or use target/leaderboard moments.

baseline_and_spatial_expected_gap.baseline: Existing fixed region-pooled logistic P(reference type present | pop_total, ALAND, urban_fraction) from scripts/estimate_gaps.py, times its one-count-ahead conditional gap 1/(model_count+1); no coefficient refit
baseline_and_spatial_expected_gap.candidate_delta: catchment facility candidate minus existing logistic facility-half baseline; nonnegative and at most 0.05 by construction
baseline_and_spatial_expected_gap.facility_candidate: unweighted mean of the three expected type gaps; all three pooled-prior types remain defined under the existing positive logistic prior
baseline_and_spatial_expected_gap.model_count: raw exact selected-category count + provided unclassified-category count multiplied by its already-provided region share, matching the existing logistic audit
baseline_and_spatial_expected_gap.spatial_adjustment: For each type and radius, multiply the existing reference-presence probability by (1 + 0.05 * (1 - kernel_access)), cap probability at 1, then apply the same conditional-gap transform. This is a fixed ≤5% relative presence-prior uplift, not a fitted coefficient or observed reference count.
baseline_and_spatial_expected_gap.urban_fraction: existing model rule: pct_urban; otherwise pop_urban/pop_total if population>0; otherwise neutral 0.5

catchments.facility_pool: All selected-type Overture bbox centers assigned to any provided ACS tract geometry in the same region package; official-scored tracts are target locations, while any extra provided tract geometries may contribute Overture context points only. Unassigned points are excluded and counted. No facilities cross region-package boundaries.
catchments.kernel_access: exp(-nearest_distance_m / radius_m); zero when the region has no selected points of that type
catchments.population_weighting: provided tract pop_total weights the centroid-based radius-coverage share and kernel-access mean; zero-population rows carry zero weight
catchments.radius_coverage: tract covered if at least one same-region selected-type Overture point is within radius, inclusive
catchments.target_location: centroid of official scored tract polygon transformed to EPSG:5070

existing_overture_summary.meaning: Validate raw point-to-tract selected-category counts and reproduce the frozen existing logistic baseline's unclassified-count treatment

official_sample.meaning: Authoritative 9,379 scored IDs and order only; sample score placeholders are never parsed or used

overture_points.category_rule: categories.primary or any categories.alternate matches the exact selected_sets in config/poi-category-definitions.json; each POI contributes at most once per facility type
overture_points.provenance: challenge-provided Overture POI point records only; no external facility list, USGS coordinates, Overture names, source metadata, confidence, or geometry column

strata.meaning: Provided population, land area and urbanity inputs; ur_class is descriptive grouping only

tract_geometry.meaning: Provided polygons only, for assigning Overture bbox centers and computing official tract representative centroids; no housing_units or other ACS columns are read

limitations: Centroid-based Euclidean catchment is a spatial context proxy, not a road-network/service-area model or a validation of facility completeness.
Population is available only at tract scale; population-weighted access assigns the tract total to its centroid and does not model within-tract population distribution.
A nearby Overture facility is not proof that an unobserved facility is absent or that an emergency service is accessible.
The existing fixed pooled logistic prior is an explicit model assumption; the fixed catchment uplift is a sensitivity, not empirically calibrated or accuracy tested.

measure_before.meaning: Freeze the existing pooled logistic facility-miss prior and category/zero-share report as baseline; do not refit its coefficients or use target/leaderboard moments.

method.purpose: analysis-only alternative facility-miss prior using challenge-provided Overture facility points and same-region spatial catchments; no target fitting, RMSE claim, or upload

reporting_plan.before: Report facility-type zero counts/shares and existing logistic expected facility-gap/candidate moments globally, per region and per region x rural/urban, sourced from the pinned audit report.
reporting_plan.determinism: Repeat full build; require byte-identical candidate CSV, report, and manifest hashes.

scope.id_order: concatenation in declared region order, preserving authoritative sample GEOID order within each region
